set.name: Date Field
set.description: Field for one date, time or datetime value. Same anatomy as Select: calendar icon (clock for the time type) + value + chevron. Opens Calendar Panel (date, datetime with Time on) or Time Panel (time) 4px below the control. Under a filled field, Equivalent shows the same value in the other calendar (Jalali ↔ Gregorian). Locale × Size × State.
